name: sql_query
description: Execute a caller-provided SELECT T-SQL statement against Azure SQL. Use TOP instead of LIMIT and bracket reserved identifiers (e.g., [Case]). No SQL generation is performed.

value_mappings.description: Optional array of value mappings for low-cardinality columns. Each mapping resolves a user-provided value to its exact database value. The MCP server will automatically replace user_value with matched_value in the query before execution.

accounts_mentioned.description: Optional account names referenced in the request (metadata only).

limit.description: Optional row cap; if provided and query lacks TOP, enforce using TOP <limit>.
